{{Top|leg}}
'''Protein wafers''' were a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]]. They could be produced by [[recycling droid]]s such as the [[Gyrowheel 1.42.08-series recycling droid|Gyrowheel 1.42.08]]. They were considered to be bland, but edible.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
